name: io.github.alphasafal/contri
description: Checks whether a GitHub issue is free to take, whether a project is alive and whether maintainers reply, before an agent starts work. Read-only, public repositories only.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional fine-grained token (public repositories, no permissions). Without it, the sign_in tool offers GitHub's device flow.
